title: Gwen Stefani & Gavin Rossdale Reunite to Support Son Kingston at His L.A. Concert Alongside Blake Shelton
summary: The exes split in 2015, and the No Doubt frontwoman married her Voice co-star six years later.
body: After all that they’ve been through, Gwen Stefani and Gavin Rossdale are cool — at least, cool enough to reunite to support their son Kingston at his recent concert, with the No Doubt frontwoman attending with husband Blake Shelton at her side. The three musicians were all in the audience Tuesday night at The Troubadour in West Hollywood, California, as Stefani and Rossdale’s eldest son rocked out onstage, according to photos circulating online. TMZ also shared video of Shelton and his fellow The Voice coaching alum holding hands as they left the venue, with Stefani at one point saying goodbye to her parents before getting into her car. body: Big bass and a quieter trip can make a huge difference on a commute, flight, or study session, and there’s a good Amazon deal on a pair built for exactly that. body: An artist’s concept depicting a Voyager spacecraft. Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech Launched nearly 50 years ago in 1977, NASA’s Voyager 1 on Wednesday, Nov. 18 will have traveled one light-day from Earth, which is more than 16 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers). Voyager 1 is the most distant human-made object, and any light from Earth would take 24 hours to reach the spacecraft. NASA will highlight this historic milestone with two events. On Tuesday, Nov. 17, NASA invites the world to participate in “Shine Bright for Voyager’s Light-Day” by creating a symbolic wave of golden light encircling the planet after sunset. NASA has created a website that enables smart phones and tablets to flash “VGR”, Voyager’s call sign, in morse code. For more information about how to participate in “Shine Bright for Voyager Light-Day,” visit: go.nasa.gov/shinebright Everyone is encouraged to capture photos or videos of their light-day signal and share it on social platforms, tagging @NASA.
